scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Welcome to the
mountain city of Payon.
If you're unfamiliar with this
area, I can help you find what
you're looking for around here.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
欢迎来到山城斐扬。
如果您不熟悉这一带，我可以帮您找到您需要的地方。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市向导

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map

scripts.text: Notice.

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
需要我在小地图上为您标记这些地点吗？

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Archer Guild handles
Job Changes to the Archer
Class. You'll need to enter
the Archer Village which is
to the northeast of Payon.

[斐扬向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[斐扬向导]
弓箭手公会负责弓箭手职业的转职。您需要前往位于斐扬东北方向的弓箭手村。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
如果您不想在小地图上显示位置标记，请对我说“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
魔法与科技的进步让我们得以更新资讯系统，现在您可以在小地图上标记位置，以便更轻松地导航。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
小地图位于屏幕的右上角。如果您看不到它，请按 Ctrl + Tab 键，或点击基础信息窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
在小地图上，点击“+”和“-”符号可以放大或缩小地图。祝您在斐扬城旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Be safe in
your travels,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[斐扬向导]
勇敢的冒险者，祝您旅途平安。
